title: Restriction to replete full quasicategories and comparison on cores
statement: Use quasicategories, coherent functor equivalences, coherent natural equivalences, full subcategories, cores and weak homotopy equivalences as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Work in a universe containing all the displayed simplicial sets. Let $P:C\to D$ be a coherent functor equivalence of small quasicategories, and let $V\subseteq D_0$ be invariant under equivalence edges: if $d\in V$ and $d\simeq d'$ in $D$, then $d'\in V$. Put $U=\{c\in C_0:P(c)\in V\}$. Write $C_U,D_V$ for the full simplicial subsets on those vertices. They are quasicategories, and $P$ restricts to a coherent functor equivalence $C_U\to D_V$. A chosen coherent quasi-inverse of $P$ restricts to a quasi-inverse of this map; the chosen units and counits restrict as well. The induced map of cores $C_U^\simeq\to D_V^\simeq$ is a weak homotopy equivalence. More generally every coherent functor equivalence $F:E\to E'$ between small quasicategories induces a weak homotopy equivalence $E^\simeq\to(E')^\simeq$: the quasi-inverse restricts to cores and the coherent inverse equivalences give simplicial homotopies on the cores. Empty full subcategories are allowed.
